name: Detroit Outdoors AdSense growth benchmark
purpose: Measure whether Detroit Outdoors grows monetizable discovery and useful onward clicks without increasing intrusive in-page ad density.
observationQuestions: Which candidate and source engine most often become the Detroit board lead?
How often does JEV use shared-harness decisions versus deterministic fallback?
How often do Haiku card drafts survive review, require retries, or require treatment reassignment?
Does the selected hero repeat across consecutive visitor sessions despite server-side image-history controls?
Which board cards and focused pages produce specialist-tool handoffs?
How often do core, editorial, hero, or focused live layers fail independently?
Do focused pages receive a live candidate, a no-window answer, or a source-unavailable answer?
Do Search Console impressions and CTR grow without adding another Detroit canonical before the review gate?
Do AdSense impressions and earnings rise without restoring intrusive in-page auto ads?
guardrails: Do not restore intrusive in-page auto ads solely to increase impression count.
Intent pages must use the same deterministic safety gates as Detroit Outdoors.
No intent page may claim a live sighting, vessel passage, water clearance, sunset color, or other condition not supported by its evidence.
Measure search landing traffic separately from internal network traffic.
Prefer useful second-page clicks over additional ad units on the first screen.
Observation telemetry must not add JEV, Haiku, AIS, weather, or other paid/live-data calls.
Do not transmit browser geolocation through Detroit observation events.

approval.scope: Execute all five Detroit Outdoors traffic and AdSense growth changes, including protected Michigan Tools surface edits.

expansionPolicy: Keep the current five Detroit canonical surfaces stable while collecting post-launch evidence.
Strengthen an existing owner before creating another Detroit URL.
A new canonical requires recurring distinct query evidence, useful downstream behavior and explicit cannibalization-safe ownership.
